summary: Tested email verification system: registration validation, disposable email rejection, MX check, login gate, token verification, resend cooldown, admin verify, and UI flows. 9/16 backend tests passed. 7 failures all due to in-memory rate limiter exhaustion during testing (5 registrations/hr/IP) - not code bugs. Core verification logic validated via code review and passing tests. UI fully functional.

minor.issue: Rate limiter counts ALL registration attempts (including rejected ones like disposable/format errors) toward the 5/hr IP limit. This means 5 failed validation attempts exhaust the limit before any real registrations. By design, but creates issues in automated test suites. Consider only counting rate limit for requests that pass initial validation.

issues: Success confirmation box has dark olive/brown background instead of green - may be CSS issue with green-500/10 transparency on dark background

action_items: Rate limiter resets on restart - tests should be run right after a backend restart for accurate results

RESEND sandbox restriction: Resend API can only deliver to account owner's email (truecursemahito28@gmail.com). Domain verification at resend.com/domains needed for sending to all users - this is a KNOWN infra issue
Consider not counting rate limit for requests that fail format/disposable/MX validation (pre-queue rejections)
critical_code_review_comments: Rate limiter in-memory (resets on restart) - not suitable for multi-process/multi-instance deployment
verify-email endpoint: verification_token stored as SHA-256 hash in DB, incoming token hashed before lookup - correctly implemented
Login gate: checks auth_type=='jwt' and is_verified==False before blocking - Google users bypass correctly
Admin verify endpoint checks email ends with @neuralearn.ai OR plan==elite - works correctly for admin@neuralearn.ai
Token unset after verification ($unset) prevents token reuse - correctly implemented

success_rate.backend: 56% (9/16) - 7 failures all due to rate limit exhaustion during test run, not code bugs

seed_data_creation: Multiple test users created with @gmail.com emails during registration tests (pending_verification status)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Email verification system was fully implemented. Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_email_verification.py. Rate limiter is in-memory (5 reg/hr, 3 resend/hr per IP) - RESTART backend before running tests to reset limiter. Key verified: registration returns requires_verification=true with exact spec message, disposable email rejected (mailinator.com), MX check works, invalid token returns INVALID_TOKEN, UI shows all 4 states (verifying/success/error/expired/resend). NOT verified via API (only code review): login gate for unverified users (code correct), resend 60s cooldown (code correct). Admin credentials: admin@neuralearn.ai / Admin@123456.
rca_of_issue: 7 backend test failures caused by in-memory rate limiter exhaustion. The register endpoint applies rate limiting BEFORE email quality validation, so even rejected requests (disposable/invalid format) count toward the 5/hr limit. Test suite makes ~10 registration calls from same IP, exhausting limit after 5 calls. All subsequent tests that require user creation fail with 429. Fix: either run tests after backend restart, or increase test rate limit, or only count rate limit after email passes validation.
